posts.content_md:
Introducing XVRWiki to the Holography forum.

XVRWiki is a wiki on 3D computing, which has overlap with holography, including dynamic holographic displays.

XVRWiki covers world-fixed displays like theoretical holographic computer monitors, and it covers near-eye holographic displays like what VividQ is doing.

Please come visit XVRWiki: [http://xvrwiki.org](http://xvrwiki.org)

A screenshot of the home page is attached to this post.
